headline: Waist-high SSE, cleanest wind of the group — dawn is fine.
today: Under-2ft short-period SSE, fair angle, but Manasquan gets the friendly wind today: light early, then SW cross-off through the afternoon so it never really blows out. Small and fast, so a log or groveler all day, best on the morning tide. Nothing special, but rideable and clean.

daysToWatch.note: Long-period ESE lines in the mix (up to 13s) on the good angle, with a light NW dawn — could be a sneaky clean little one. Small, so log it. Wind swings onshore by evening.
Prime ESE angle and a 3.6ft total wave, but 10-14mph S cross all day keeps it disorganized. Marginal call — clean it up in your head before making the drive.
